slides.title: Negative and restrictive inversion
slides.subtitle: Not only, hardly, no sooner, little, under no circumstances
goals: Use inversion after negative and restrictive adverbials.
Form it accurately in all tenses.

head: Adverbial
Example
rows: **Not only did** she win, but she also broke the record.
**Hardly had** I sat down **when** the phone rang.
**No sooner had** we arrived **than** it began to snow.
**Little did** they know what awaited them.
**Only when** I read it **did I** understand.
Under no circumstances / On no account
**On no account should you** share your password.
**Not until** the end **did** we realize the truth.

items.q: No sooner ___ than the alarm went off.
Little ___ that he was being watched.
Only after the meeting ___ the problem.

items.t: Not only ___ he late, but he also forgot the documents.
Hardly ___ we started when the power went out.
